summary: Persist one durable resource execution receipt per terminal charged shell membership

replay.detail: Terminal shell state and its resource.exec-receipt claim commit atomically. Nested executions retain one receipt for their charged membership.

schema.detail: Adds the durable system-only resource.exec-receipt claim with declared resource profile, execution observations, owner, coverage and head-first query subjects.

rules.detail: Receipts describe completed execution and do not grant resource capacity or change admission policy.

compatibility.detail: Existing shell command rows remain readable. Receipt consumers require upgraded execution hosts; older executions do not gain retrospective claims. Client-v0 contracts are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No deployment or host restart is required by the schema addition.

manual.detail: Query resource.exec-receipt with claims ls by start-head subject prefix and inspect host, class, declared profile, coverage and actual observed outcome; absent measurements are not zero.

recovery.detail: Recovery and owner-expiration teardown persist payload observations before retiring native custody. Recovered live helpers receive one bounded notification-driven observation grace; unavailable payload exit evidence remains absent.
